legend: Light chain deposition disease. Low-power view showing nodular glomerulosclerosis: the mesangial nodules stain black (JMS) (<<33494>>). High-power image of a glomerulus showing nodular mesangial expansion by PAS-positive mesangial sclerosis and glassy immune deposits; the glomerular basement membrane is mildly thickened with segmental duplication (PAS) (<<33498>>). On immunofluorescence, there is bright diffuse linear staining of the basement membranes of glomeruli, tubules, and vessel wall myocytes for kappa light chain (<<33499>>), with negative staining for lambda light chain (<<33502>>). On electron microscopy, punctate, powdery, electron-dense deposits are present extensively along the outer aspect of the tubular basement membrane (<<33505>>) and the inner aspect of the glomerular basement membrane (<<33506>>).
